question: Does any alternative path achieve coherence once this path is rejected?
premises: Everything established here fits coherently by this path.
Rejecting this path leaves no alternative framework.
No other proposed path attains logical coherence.
inference: Therefore the stated path alone is coherent and alternatives fail.
plain_english: Since everything established here fits together by this path, the whole system is coherent. If one rejects this path, surely no other approach attains any coherence at all.
